payload.core_mechanism_summary: Brute-force enumeration of all 5-vertex combinations from a reduced graph (at most 48 vertices) using five nested loops, checking each for being a clique or independent set.
payload.rationale: The solution systematically generates all combinations of 5 vertices via nested loops (a form of backtracking without recursion). No pruning or bound functions are used, so it's a simple exhaustive search over subsets.
